Website information

Privacy

This website introduces April Johnson’s real estate services. The information below describes how the current website works.

Inquiry forms

When you submit an inquiry form, the details you enter (such as your name, contact information, interests and message) are sent securely to April Johnson’s customer relationship management system, Lofty, so she can respond to you. They are used to answer your inquiry and follow up about your real estate plans, and are not sold. If the form cannot be sent, it offers to open the message in your email app instead. To ask April to update or delete your information, email her at the address below.

Email and phone links

If you choose to send an email or make a call, your email or telephone provider processes that communication. Information you choose to send to April is received through that channel.

Browsing and hosting

This build does not add advertising trackers, analytics scripts or tracking cookies. The hosting provider may process technical connection information and access controls needed to serve the website. Site access may require signing in during private review.

Questions

For questions about information you have shared with April, contact aprilj@1stclassre.com.

Future changes

This notice will be updated if property-search tools, analytics or other services that collect visitor information are added.

April Johnson is your trusted real estate partner across Columbus, Phenix City and East Alabama, helping people find their dream home.
